title: std/audio-chunk@1
description: A slice of PCM audio. Signed 16-bit little-endian samples, base64-encoded. `final` marks an utterance or clause boundary, not the end of the stream — that is kind:done.

final.description: End of an utterance or clause.

seq.description: Chunk index within the stream, so a receiver can detect a gap when a realtime channel drops one.

ref.description: Reserved. Forward compatibility for carrying samples out of band; unused in v1, and a receiver may ignore it.
